verdict.rationale: Filing deadlines and late-payment penalty schedules are a fair question for an IP office such as INPI, so the axis applies. The evidence pack contains only page titles for filing procedures (trademark, patent, design, e-Soleau, provisional application) and no published deadlines, penalty amounts or interest figures, so nothing supports this story.

support.subject: As a founder, the filing deadlines and the penalty and interest schedule for missing them are published with exact figures
